prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A hyper-realistic, close-up shot of an oversized cheeseburger placed on a wooden table inside a fast-food restaurant. The burger is stacked high with layers of fresh green lettuce, thick slices of tomato, juicy beef patties, and melted cheddar cheese oozing over the sides, all encased in a perfectly round sesame seed bun. The background features large windows revealing a bustling cityscape, with soft daylight streaming in, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere. Diners can be seen in the softly blurred background, adding a sense of liveliness and authenticity to the scene. Prominent fast-food signage with bold red and yellow colors is visible both inside and outside the restaurant, evoking a familiar, iconic brand without using its actual name. The color palette is vibrant, emphasizing the rich browns of the burger, the fresh greens and reds of the vegetables, and the golden hues of the cheese and bun. The composition uses a shallow depth of field to keep the focus sharply on the burger, with a slight cinematic quality reminiscent of food advertising photography—crisp, appetizing, and larger-than-life.
